note: Italian calibration set for the paraphrase matcher, written 2026-11-12 before any score was computed. `bank`: the sample-interview bank as prep would write it for an Italian meeting (question + 3 paraphrases per entry, translated from the English bank). `blind`: 3 spoken paraphrases per entry b001-b020, translated freely from bench/embed/blind_set.json (which was written blind to the bank), never from the Italian bank paraphrases. `asr`: one paraphrase per entry the way a speech recognizer delivers it (lower case, no punctuation, fillers, misheard names, missing accents). `near`: the 20 questions of en_near.json (on an entry's topic, not answered by it). `offbank`: the 40 distractors of blind_set.json (off-bank questions and small-talk statements).
